This 7UP Pound Cake was our absolute favorite growing up. The lemon-lime soda adds the perfect hint of flavor to an already delicious cake. There's a reason this recipe has been passed down for generations, and now we're here to pass it down to you. Find the full recipe for this delicious 7UP Pound Cake below!👇️⁠
⁠
✨Don't forget to save this recipe for later!✨⁠
⁠
Ingredients:⁠
• 3 ½ cups White Lily All-Purpose Flour, sifted⁠
• ¼ tsp salt⁠
• 1 ½ cups butter, room temperature⁠
• 3 cups sugar⁠
• 6 eggs, room temperature⁠
• ¾ cup 7UP, room temperature ⁠
• 1 tsp lemon extract⁠
• 1 tsp vanilla extract⁠
⁠
1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour and salt until well combined. Set aside.⁠
2. Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy (about 5-7 minutes in a stand mixer at medium speed)⁠
3. Beat in eggs, one at a time, until yolks disappear before adding another.⁠
4. Reduce speed to low. Alternate between flour and 7UP, beginning and ending with flour. (flour, 7UP, flour, 7UP, flour)⁠
5. Beat in extracts until fully combined.⁠
6. Pour into a prepared tube pan (a similar one can be found from @oldcountrykitchenware).⁠
7. Place into a cold oven and set the temperature to 325F.⁠
8. Bake for 1 hour 10 minutes or until a toothpick comes out mostly clean.⁠
9. Place onto a wire rack and allow to cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan to cool completely.⁠
⁠
Enjoy!❤️
